#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bidirectional Key-Segment stream engine.

Subcommands
-----------
compile : read a JSON configuration on stdin, write a compiled program object.
stream  : read one JSON request per line, write one JSON response per line.

Only the Python standard library is used.
"""

import base64
import heapq
import json
import sys

try:  # the transport may carry large decimal integer tokens
    sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
except Exception:
    pass

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- constants
MAX_OPEN = 4096
MAX_CHUNK = 1024
MAX_FLOW_ID = 2147483647
MAX_TIME = 9007199254740991
ALPHA = 4097            # signed feature alphabet size, [-2048, 2048]
AOFF = 2048             # feature -> alphabet index offset
MAX_TOTAL_POS = 16384

R_KEY = 1
R_IDLE = 2
R_PLIM = 3
R_END = 4
RNAME = ("", "key", "idle", "packet_limit", "end")

ERR_EVENT = b'{"error":"event"}\n'
ERR_CONFIG = b'{"error":"config"}'
NO_EVENTS = b'{"events":[]}\n'

CFG_KEYS = frozenset(("version", "idle_timeout", "packet_limit",
                      "prefix_width", "rules", "fallback"))
RULE_KEYS = frozenset(("id", "class", "priority", "ranges"))
LEAF_KEYS = frozenset(("class",))
NODE_KEYS = frozenset(("feature", "threshold", "le", "gt"))

OPEN_KEYS = frozenset(("op", "flow", "time"))
CHUNK_KEYS = frozenset(("op", "packets"))
PKT_KEYS = frozenset(("flow", "time", "source", "length"))
TICK_KEYS = frozenset(("op", "time"))
CLOSE_KEYS = frozenset(("op", "flow", "time"))
CKPT_KEYS = frozenset(("op",))
RESTORE_KEYS = frozenset(("op", "checkpoint"))


class BadConfig(Exception):
    pass
